findings.title: validator accepts incomplete present G2 placeholder
findings.required_action: Require signature algorithm/key/certificate chain, validity/trusted time, policy/EKU/key usage/name constraints, revocation freshness, and source/candidate/evidence/hash bindings before present.

findings.title: typed absence accountability is not enforced per record
findings.required_action: Require non-null owner, authoritative source, and recovery condition (or an explicit typed owner-unspecified state) on every absent record and validate the linkage.

findings.title: no canonical no-repeat input fingerprint
findings.required_action: Record a deterministic complete bundle/input fingerprint and use it to suppress duplicate AD/rerun for unchanged inputs.

findings.title: source-candidate-evidence bidirectional binding is not verified
findings.required_action: Materialize and verify inverse edges, dereference evidence, recompute content hashes, and compare URI/hash/media/schema/owner byte-for-byte.

findings.title: snapshot receipt drifts and omits dirty status in manifest
findings.required_action: Freeze one exact HEAD/tree/status/patch tuple, record all four hashes, and independently recompute them; fix source-hash field validation precedence.

findings.title: environment dependency closure remains unbound
findings.required_action: Bind imports, module paths, package/channel/build/artifact closure, exact env values or a deterministic redaction receipt, locale/timezone provenance, and candidate identity.

findings.title: binary provenance is shape-only and unsigned
findings.required_action: Verify executable existence and bytes, publisher signature, origin, build recipe, SBOM, license, and candidate-bound import closure.

findings.title: future G2 present path lacks security and canonical-schema enforcement
findings.required_action: Enforce typed fields, duplicate/unknown-field rejection, interval/trusted-time, policy OID/EKU/key-usage, ambiguity/conflict and revocation/OCSP/CRL freshness before promotion.

findings.title: raw receipt linkage is partial
findings.required_action: Add combined run receipt and input/output artifact hash map tied to PID, UTC and exit.
